focus: 主持審查會：開場、收線、結案
lead: 今天練的是你是那個主持會議的人：45 分鐘、14 個人、三個議題，其中兩個要當場拍板。心法 —— 開場先宣告「今天要決定什麼」，結尾先唸 action 再散會；中間你的工作不是回答問題，是控制節奏。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Let's take two minutes on the agenda so we know what we're deciding today.
phrases.gl: 開場先講議程，並且點名「今天要決定什麼」（主持人的第一個動作是設定期待，不是寒暄）
phrases.ex: Let's take two minutes on the agenda so we know what we're deciding today — vehicle slots, the storage budget, and one open question on tunnel coverage.

phrases.en: Three items on the list. Two of them need a decision, one is just an FYI.
phrases.gl: 把「要決定的」和「只是同步的」分開（大家就知道哪裡該用力，哪裡可以放過）
phrases.ex: Three items on the list. Two of them need a decision today, and the tunnel coverage one is just an FYI so nobody re-opens it.

phrases.en: Let me park that — I'll put it on the list and we'll come back if there's time.
phrases.gl: 把離題的東西「停車」，而不是壓下去（parking lot 是主持人最重要的工具，對方會覺得被聽見，但節奏還在你手上）
phrases.ex: Let me park the rolling shutter question — I'll put it on the list and we'll come back if there's time at the end.
phrases.fix: 取代 “We can discuss about it later”

phrases.en: Kevin, can you give us the two-sentence version? Let's go deep offline.
phrases.gl: 請人濃縮發言，並給他一個之後可以講完的出口（不是打斷，是換場地）
phrases.ex: Kevin, can you give us the two-sentence version — does it block the September collection or not? Let's go deep offline after this.

phrases.en: I want to hear from the vehicle side before we lock this.
phrases.gl: 主動點名還沒發言、但會被決定影響的人（避免會後才冒出反對意見）
phrases.ex: Before we lock this, I want to hear from the vehicle side. Ivy, six slots in September — is that realistic with the maintenance window?

phrases.en: So where we've landed is ___. Anyone see it differently?
phrases.gl: 把浮動的討論收成一句結論，然後測反對意見（比問「大家同意嗎」更容易釣出真話）
phrases.ex: So where we've landed is six slots, four on highway routes and two urban. Anyone see it differently?

phrases.en: That's a real problem — it's just not today's problem.
phrases.gl: 承認對方的議題有價值，但不是這場會的範圍（拒絕離題但不傷人）
phrases.ex: The labeling vendor queue is a real problem — it's just not today's problem. I'll set up a separate half hour next week.

phrases.en: We're at time. Let me close on the two decisions and take the third to email.
phrases.gl: 時間到就硬收，並說明沒講完的東西去哪裡（拖時間會讓人下次不想來）
phrases.ex: We're at time. Let me close on the two decisions and take the storage budget to email — I'll send options by end of day.

phrases.en: Let me read back the actions before we drop off.
phrases.gl: 散會前當場唸一次 action、負責人、日期（會後補記錄太晚，人已經散了）
phrases.ex: Let me read back the actions before we drop off: Ivy confirms the slots by Tuesday, Kevin re-runs calibration on the two spare rigs by Thursday, I take the storage numbers to David.
phrases.fix: 取代 “I will send the meeting minutes later”

setup: Setup. You are chairing the Friday collection review — 45 minutes, 14 people on the call, and you have three items. First, vehicle slots for September: the vehicle team can offer six, and you asked for nine. Second, the storage budget: the fleet is generating about 18 TB a week of rosbag data and you are 40 TB over the quarterly allocation. Third, an FYI that GNSS coverage drops out on roughly 12% of the tunnel routes. Kevin, your perception lead, has been wanting to walk everyone through a rolling shutter artifact he found — it is interesting, it is not on the agenda, and it will eat twenty minutes if you let it. Ivy from the vehicle team joins five minutes late, and David, the program manager, is on the call for the first ten minutes only.

prompts.q: You open the call. Fourteen people, cameras mostly off, and David is only staying for ten minutes.
prompts.frame: Name the clock → list the three items → say which two need a decision → say what you need from the room → hand off to the first item.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段開場（目標 35 秒），不要以 “OK so, umm, maybe we can start” 起頭，直接進結構。
prompts.model: “Alright, let's get started — we've got 45 minutes and David's with us for the first ten, so I'll front-load anything he needs to weigh in on. Three items today. One: September vehicle slots. Two: the storage budget, we're 40 terabytes over. Three: an FYI on tunnel GNSS coverage — that one's just so you've seen it, I'm not asking anyone to solve it today. Items one and two need a decision before we drop off, and I'd rather we make an imperfect call today than a perfect one next Friday. What I need from you is the constraint, not the solution — if something on your side blocks this, say it now rather than in the chat afterwards. Ivy, let's start with slots.”

prompts.q: Six minutes in, Kevin has taken the slot discussion into rolling shutter artifacts and is sharing his screen. David has four minutes left on the call.
prompts.frame: Interrupt cleanly with his name → acknowledge the substance in one clause → ask the only question that matters for today → park the rest with a concrete home → hand back to the agenda item.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「打斷但不得罪人」——不要說 sorry to interrupt 三次，一次就好，重點在你立刻給他一個出口。
prompts.model: “Kevin — let me jump in here. This is good, and I do want the full walkthrough. For right now, one question: does the rolling shutter issue block us from running September collection on those two rigs, yes or no? … Okay, so it's a data quality question, not a scheduling blocker. Then let me park it — I'm putting it on the list and I'll book us thirty minutes on Monday with you and Rachel. That's a real problem, it's just not today's problem, and I want David in the room for the slot decision before he drops. Ivy, back to you — six slots. Where does the seventh one break?”

prompts.q: Four minutes left. The slot decision is made, the storage budget is still half-argued, and two people are talking over each other about retention policy.
prompts.frame: Call time out loud → state the decision that was made, in one sentence → say explicitly what is NOT decided and where it goes → read back actions with owner and date → close.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「硬收尾」——每個 action 都必須有人名和日期，不能出現 we will follow up。
prompts.model: “We're at time, so I'm going to close. Decision one: six vehicle slots in September, four highway and two urban — that's agreed, Ivy owns it. Decision two, storage: we did not land it, and I'm not going to land it in three minutes with people talking over each other. I'm taking it to email — I'll send two options by end of day, keep everything for 90 days and buy more storage, or drop raw camera after 30 days once the rosbags are extracted. Reply by Monday noon or I'll pick one. Actions before we drop off: Ivy confirms the six slots with the maintenance team by Tuesday. Kevin sends me the rolling shutter summary by Monday and we meet Monday afternoon. I take the storage options to David today. Nothing else is open. Thanks, everyone — have a good weekend.”

fixes.bad: Let's discuss about the storage budget in the next meeting.
fixes.good: Let's take the storage budget at the next meeting.
fixes.note: Grammar：discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，沒有 about。另外主持人說 take an item（把某項挪到某場會）比 discuss 更像在調度議程。

fixes.bad: Because the vehicle team is very busy, so we cannot get nine slots.
fixes.good: The vehicle team is stretched this quarter, so we can only get six slots.
fixes.note: Grammar：中文的「因為…所以…」在英文只能留一邊，Because 和 so 不能同時出現。順便把 very busy 換成 stretched，聽起來是資源問題，不是態度問題。

fixes.bad: The datas from three vehicle is not enough to train the model.
fixes.good: The data from three vehicles isn't enough to train the model.
fixes.note: Plurals：data 是不可數，沒有 datas；three 後面 vehicle 要加 s；主詞是不可數的 data，動詞用 is（縮寫成 isn't 更口語）。

fixes.bad: Maybe we can try to see if it is possible to finish before Friday, I think.
fixes.good: I need this closed by Friday. Kevin, can you commit to that?
fixes.note: Vagueness：maybe / try to see / possible / I think 四層護身符疊在一起，聽的人不知道你到底要不要。主持人要給一個日期，再點名要一個 yes 或 no。

fixes.bad: Please kindly give me your feedbacks before Monday.
fixes.good: Send me any corrections by Monday.
fixes.note: Register：kindly 在英文母語職場聽起來過度客氣、甚至有點古板；feedback 不可數，沒有 feedbacks。主持會議時用祈使句是正常的，不會沒禮貌。

challenge:
今天在你主持的任何一場會（哪怕只有三個人）做這兩件事：

開場：“Three items on the list. Two of them need a decision today — ___ and ___. The third is just an FYI.”

收尾：“Let me read back the actions before we drop off: ___ by ___, ___ by ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：錄一段「開場 30 秒 + 收尾 30 秒」。

  • 開場必須出現時間長度、議題數量，以及「哪幾項要決定」
  • 中間必須練一次 park：Let me park that — I'll put it on the list
  • 收尾的每個 action 都要有人名 + 日期，一個都不能少
  • 沒有決定的事，要明講「沒有決定」以及它去哪裡（email／下次會議）
  • 禁用：discuss about、Because…, so…、we will follow up、kindly
check: 我開場的時候，有沒有讓每個人都知道「今天散會前要決定哪兩件事」？
有人離題的時候，我是陪他走完，還是一句話 park 掉並給他一個具體的去處？
散會前我有沒有當場唸出 action、負責人和日期，而不是說「我會補會議紀錄」？
